exclusions.name: Elena Cruz
exclusions.why_safe: She oversees receipts but does not control collection rate or shipping schedule, so her actions do not affect the number of units received.

exclusions.name: Expiration of blood units
exclusions.why_safe: Blood units have a shelf life, but no evidence of expiration dates or that any units expire within the week. Excluding expiration is safe if all units remain usable; otherwise it could overestimate. Unknown.

exclusions.name: Hospital usage or consumption of blood units
exclusions.why_safe: The question asks for units the hospital 'holds' at the deadline, not net after usage. Usage would only reduce the count, so excluding it gives an upper bound; but the resolution note says 'actually holds', implying inventory after any internal use. However, no evidence of usage is provided, so we assume no usage for simplicity. This exclusion is safe only if usage is zero; otherwise it could overestimate. But given no evidence, we must treat it as unknown.

exclusions.name: Other hospitals or blood centres
exclusions.why_safe: Only St. Vincent regional hospital is mentioned as receiving shipments from the Cascade centre. No other recipients are indicated, so excluding them is safe.

exclusions.name: Weekend collections (Saturday/Sunday)
exclusions.why_safe: The drive is only open Monday to Friday, so no weekend collections occur. Excluding them is safe.
